title: Multiscale Sliced Wasserstein Distances as Perceptual Color Difference Measures
tldr_zh: 多尺度 SWD 在 CIELAB 空间做 training-free 感知色差度量，对错位图像对稳健，可当颜色迁移损失
tldr_en: Multiscale sliced Wasserstein distance in CIELAB as a training-free perceptual color difference measure robust to misalignment

key_numbers.number: 0.841 PLCC / 0.805 SRCC on non-perfectly aligned SPCD pairs
0.794 PLCC / 0.772 SRCC on all SPCD pairs, best overall
0.836 PLCC under horizontal flipping, vs CD-Flow 0.393
0.05M trainable parameters for learned version, 0.08% of CD-Flow's 60.49M
9.5 ms average inference time at P=128 on NVIDIA A100
100,000 random triplets tested, no triangle inequality violations
